purpose: Preserve the provenance chain showing how the older JANUS 113.8 / Fundamentum verifier philosophy acquired bounded executable safeguards in DemiHead without rewriting the historical conceptual artifact into a claim of prior implementation or infallibility.

lineage.name: JANUS Fundamentum threshold architecture
inherited_ideas: multiple competing hypotheses remain witnessed before commitment
independent verification precedes a supported commit
insufficient evidence and budget exhaustion are valid open terminals
discarded branches remain in a proof-carrying witness ledger
low loss, low energy, confidence or majority are not truth
human authority remains separate from computational confidence

lineage.name: JANUS 113.8 system profile and safe normalization
inherited_ideas: successful low-error patterns are not automatically truth
records require provenance, confidence, scope, timestamps, verifier status and supersession links
selection must not erase excluded witnesses
integrity verification must fail closed rather than self-repair silently

lineage.name: DemiHead Epistemic Execution Gate
realized_ideas: current-state claims require current source receipts
no evidence produces EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT instead of a guessed value

lineage.name: DemiHead Fundamentum Truth Guard
realized_ideas: material live plurality blocks premature definitive collapse
UA/RU/EN translation cannot upgrade evidence, urgency or authority
verified root corrections propagate to known provenance descendants without deleting historical nodes
unverified corrections remain pending rather than promoted

post_merge_main.meaning: The exact merge commit independently replayed the repository validation and new truth-guard checks on main.

architectural_translation.historical_phrase: JANUS witnesses competing hypotheses before any one becomes the answer.
architectural_translation.executable_reference_form: manifest candidates -> witness ledger -> receipt-bound assessment -> hold/open/commit terminal

established: A deterministic local reference implementation now enforces the listed receipt, witness-ledger, language-invariance and correction-propagation rules for its supported schemas.
Both the exact PR head and exact post-merge main commit passed the configured CI suite.
not_established: JANUS is universally incapable of producing false statements
JANUS 113.8 was already executable when the historical profile was written
passing an internal gate establishes objective or universal truth
internal CI substitutes for independent external validation
the system is conscious, alive or infallible
the guard grants authority over a human or external system

fuzz UA/RU/EN semantic invariance with adversarial translation drift
